page_title: ALA 1-1 CEL | Alaves v Celta Vigo 27/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Francisco Maeso is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+3' Toni Martinez (Alaves) is penalised for a foul. Francisco Maeso had a clear view and blows his whistle.
90+2' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
90+1' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
90+1' A substitution has been made. Kike Garcia goes off and Toni Martinez (Alaves) comes on.

90+1' Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
90' The Celta Vigo players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
87' The ball possession is 49:51.
85' Substitution. Fernando Lopez (Celta Vigo) on for Pablo Duran.
82' The referee gives a yellow card to Kike Garcia (Alaves) for talking back. He must be careful for the remainder of the match.
81' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
81' Asier Villalibre (Alaves) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
80' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
78' Abdel Abqar (Alaves) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
78' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
76' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) sends a screamer well wide of the right post from the edge of the box.
75' Substitution. Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Mihailo Ristic walks off.
75' Celta Vigo have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
75' A cross from Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
71' Eduardo Coudet has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Carlos Martin (Alaves) replacing Tomas Conechny.
71' It is time for a substitution. Asier Villalibre (Alaves) is on for Carlos Protesoni.
70' That looked a certain handball by Carl Starfelt (Celta Vigo) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
69' Celta Vigo quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
69' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
66' 1 - 1 Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) latches on to a superb pass and breaks through the defence before firing a shot from mid-range that goes past the goalkeeper inside the left post.
64' Mihailo Ristic (Celta Vigo) has tested the patience of referee Francisco Maeso and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
63' We are about to witness a subsitution. Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo) for Borja Iglesias.
63' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) shoots from distance but it's wayward and goes high over the bar.
63' The ball is cleared after Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
60' Francisco Maeso couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Kike Garcia (Alaves) and blew his whistle. Free kick. Celta Vigo will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
56' The ball rebounds off the defender into the path of Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo), who immediately strikes for goal from inside the box but sends it a whisker over the bar.
54' Vicente Guaita displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Jon Guridi (Alaves) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
49' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Alaves. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.
49' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) sprays a pass out to Jon Guridi, but he can't beat his man inside the box.
49' Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
49' The resulting set piece from Celta Vigo is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
48' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Jesus Owono makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Franco Cervi comes off for Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo).
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Yoel Lago is replaced by Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' A pass by Jon Guridi (Alaves) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.
45+1' 2 additional min. will be played.
42' The game is interrupted as Kike Garcia (Alaves) is flagged offside.
40' Celta Vigo keep the ball well and push forward with purpose, but here comes an interception from the opposition.
38' Good defending. Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) tries to find Pablo Duran inside the box, but the pass is cut out. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
37' Jon Guridi (Alaves) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Kike Garcia. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.
36' A poorly executed mid-range free kick by Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) as he fails to deliver a decent cross. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Celta Vigo.
36' A mid-range free kick is awarded to Alaves out wide and from this angle a cross into the box is likely.
35' Francisco Maeso blows his whistle after Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
33' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) goes into the referee's book for dissent.
33' Manu Sanchez (Alaves) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent. Celta Vigo are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
31' Total attempts – 1:0.
30' Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Franco Cervi.
27' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Celta Vigo, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
27' Francisco Maeso blows for a foul after Jon Guridi (Alaves) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
24' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
20' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) sends a cross in and finds Borja Iglesias inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in and clears the danger.

20' Mihailo Ristic (Celta Vigo) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant low pass, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem. That should have been a goalscoring opportunity. The ball is out of play. Celta Vigo will take a throw-in.
17' Alaves are just stroking the ball across the park now, but the defence is doing very well breaking up their possession.
13' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.
10' A corner kick by Alaves is thwarted by the well prepared Vicente Guaita (Celta Vigo).
10' An attempted cross from Carlos Vicente (Alaves) is cleared.
8' The corner is swung in but Celta Vigo can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
8' Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
6' 1 - 0 Kike Garcia (Alaves) steps up and confidently powers the spot kick into the bottom left corner.
6' Kike Garcia (Alaves) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
5' It’s a PENALTY to Alaves after the VAR review!
4' Referee Francisco Maeso makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Alaves. Let’s see what happens!
4' Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
3' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Alaves comes to nothing.
3' The cross into the penalty area from Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Celta Vigo will take the kick-off.
Francisco Maeso will officiate today.
Show lineups Both teams starting lineups are available now, so you can have a look at them.
